listing.name: R4: Ridge Racer Type 4 — RidgeRacerType4Recomp (tetrisgm)
listing.summary: Information only. The project reports an early R4 preview reaching startup and races, with VSLink claims for two to four players. Committed game-derived C and applicable package rights remain unresolved, so new downloads are unavailable. The own-disc preview does not establish a full playthrough, VSLink compatibility or permission for automated distribution. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.

restrictions.explanation: New downloads are unavailable while the committed game-derived C and applicable package redistribution rights remain unresolved. A full playthrough and VSLink are unconfirmed by Portcove. Information about the own-disc preview is retained under its existing identity; package rights and trust require review before automated distribution.

decisions.rationale: Retain the same GitHub repository and Portcove listing after independently verifying the numeric redirect, retained source history and current project requirements.

evidence.note: On 2026-11-19 the former address returned HTTP 301 to /repositories/1388401672. The new canonical address returns the existing repository ID.
The current guide still requires the original SLUS-00797 disc and retains the psxrecomp implementation. The historical README and v0.1.0 and v0.2.0 release history remain in this repository.
Retain the historical project association and original-game requirements.

decisions.reconsider_when: Review a new observed repository ID, contradictory implementation history or changed source requirements before accepting any further relocation.
